usedFor: Shopify holds the store's products, and Linkly creates a tracked link for each through “Create Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Link” in Linkly
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets a Linkly link, set up before you share the product.

watchOut: “Create Domain” in Linkly adds a new domain, so pair it with a trigger only on purpose.
